nuggets.text: Ben Johnson walked on at North Carolina as a reserve quarterback before becoming the Bears head coach.
Ben Johnson spent a year as a software developer in Durham, North Carolina, before he got into coaching.
A Chicago hot dog stand promised free hot dogs if Ben Johnson celebrated a win shirtless, and after beating the Eagles, he did.
Caleb Williams set the Bears single-season passing record in 2025 with 3,942 yards, breaking Erik Kramer's 1995 mark.
Caleb Williams got the nickname "Iceman" from Bears teammate Luther Burden III.
Caleb Williams set an NFL record last season with seven fourth-quarter comebacks, counting the playoffs.
Caleb Williams led the Bears back from 21-6 down in the fourth quarter to beat the Packers 31-27 in last season's playoffs.
Sunday is the first meeting between former No. 1 overall pick quarterbacks Caleb Williams and Bryce Young.
The Bears traded the 2023 No. 1 overall pick to Carolina, and the Panthers used it on Sunday's opposing QB, Bryce Young.
The Bears got their name as a nod to the Chicago Cubs, since young bears are called cubs.
